Class ReportState

java.lang.Object
edu.tamu.project2.csce331.ReportState
public final class ReportState extends Object
Global, in-memory state for report calculations.

This utility holds a single logical LocalDate used by reporting screens (e.g., X and Z reports). It initializes lazily to the current system date and offers simple getters/setters with basic thread safety via synchronized methods.

Thread-safety
  • All public methods are synchronized, making access safe across JavaFX and background threads.
  • State is process-local only; it is not persisted.
Usage
  • Call getCurrentDate() to retrieve the current logical date.
  • Use setCurrentDate(LocalDate) to override for testing or to align reports to a specific day.
  • incrementDay() advances the logical date by five days to facilitate time-skipping during demos/tests.
